title: Abandoned Shack Extract
info: You will need to use the key to find out if this extract is open or not - you are unable to tell from the outside. This extract, if open, will remain open through the entire duration of the map and can be used at anytime by anyone as long as it's open.

title: Abandoned RV Extract
info:
This extract is seemingly rarely open. Find your way into the RV with a Toolbox on you to use this extract.

Requires: Toolbox x1

title: Beach Villa Main Bedroom Key
info: Key tom the main bedroom on the second floor of the Beach Villa in the Valley. The owner left behind a lot of valuables.

title: Beach Villa Storage Key
info: Key to the storage room on the first floor of the Beach Villa in the Valley. The storage room holds expensive valuables that were left behind.

title: RV Camp Cabin Cafeteria Key
info: Key to the log cabin Cafeteria in the Valley RV Camp. Once a popular dining spot for RV enthusiasts, it was later used as a stronghold by the locals. Rumor has it there are a lot of valuables there.

title: Helipad Extract
info:
Requires the Valley Boss Token, dropped by the scav boss nearby. Takes 60 seconds.

Cutoff for getting to the extract: 20 seconds left on countdown.

When it reaches 0, everyone in the extract will extract.

title: Barn Rat Spot
info: When given the Beachhead Positions spawn, I enjoy running over near this mark and laying down in the tree line. If you position yourself correctly, you can see two of the entrances to Beach Villa.

title: Barn Rat Spot
info:
Great sniping spot if you are lucky enough to get the spawn here. Find a bush that covers you mostly and direct your aim towards the yellow weapons crate that sits high up in Supply Camp. This one requires a bit of patience, but is almost always worth it.

Also is a great spot to wait and listen for players to arrive at Small Factory.
